::: {#def-reference-level}
#### Reference level

The **reference level** of a categorical variable
is the category that is represented
by all indicator variables equal to 0.
:::

::: notes
The choice of a reference level is arbitrary.
It does not limit what the indicator variables can describe.
It makes comparisons with the reference level convenient.

For example,
female is the reference level for chromosomal sex $S$
when using the indicator variable $M$ for male.
In @exr-dummy-coding,
category A1 is the reference level for the variable `behpat`.
:::
